note: Values are Panera Bread's official U.S. nutrition figures (Nutrition Guide effective September 2, 2026), checked on October 25, 2026. Salads and bowls include their dressing as served. Menus vary by bakery-cafe — confirm current figures with Panera.

meta.values_origin: Every item was checked on 2026-10-25 against Panera Bread's official U.S. Nutrition Guide (effective 9/2/2026) linked from panerabread.com. Salads and bowls are listed as served (with dressing); drink sizes are as Panera lists them.
meta.serving_basis: One standard menu serving as named, standard recipe, no customizations unless listed as an add-on.
meta.addon_macros: Add-ons (cream cheese, extra Caesar dressing) use Panera's published values for one portion, so all values are included in totals.

changelog.change: Added provenance metadata (market, official reference, review status). Nutrition values unchanged.

Full review against the official U.S. source listed above. All values replaced with official figures; items no longer on the official U.S. menu or not published by the restaurant were removed or replaced with the official equivalent; add-ons without official values were removed. Removed/replaced ids: napa-almond-chicken-whole, turkey-bacon-avocado-half. New ids: toasted-italiano-half.

Full re-check against Panera's Nutrition Guide (effective 9/2/2026). All existing values matched. Added saturated fat, sugar and fiber to every item, cream cheese add-ons for bagels, and the rest of the menu: bagels and bakery, breakfast sandwiches, souffles and oatmeal, all soups and mac in cup, bowl and bread bowl, salads (half and whole), Salad Stuffers, Market Bowls, sandwiches (half and whole), kids items, sides and drinks. Catering, group sizes, drive-thru with-ice drinks and no-nut salad variants are not listed. Kettle chips left out (fiber shown as <1).
